name: Simple Chords & Rhythms
instructions: A basic major chord (a "triad") is built from three notes: the root, a note 4 half-steps up, and another 3 half-steps up from there (e.g., C-E-G for C major).
Practice playing a C major chord with your right hand (thumb, middle, and pinky fingers), keeping your hand relaxed.
Play the chord in a simple steady rhythm (four even beats) to connect chords with timing from the very start.
Watch today's video for simple chords paired with rhythm.
